comment: Route pack areas: NOAA Chart Display Service (NCDS) regions, built from every active ENC cell that covers them (ncds_bbox = NOAA's region rectangle), (legacy areas built from state sets, with states + bbox, still work). Each area's 'tests' run on its own pack; top-level 'tests' run on the packs listed in their 'areas'. 'nm' is the accepted length range, 'fail' marks routes that must be refused, 'avoid' lists [lat, lon, meters] the route must keep away from. Nothing is published unless every test passes.

areas.name: Region 02a: Long Island Sound and the Hudson
areas.description: Long Island Sound north of 41.1 N and its east end, the Hudson River from Haverstraw to Troy, the Connecticut and Rhode Island coasts, Block Island Sound and Narragansett Bay.

areas.name: Region 03: New York Harbor and New Jersey
areas.description: New York Harbor and the Hudson to the Tappan Zee, western Long Island Sound, Long Island's south shore, the NJ coast north of Barnegat, and the Delaware River from Wilmington to Trenton.

areas.name: Region 04: Upper Chesapeake and Delaware Bay
areas.description: Upper and mid Chesapeake (Susquehanna Flats to Solomons), the Potomac to Washington, the C&D Canal, Delaware Bay and River to Wilmington, the NJ coast from Cape May to Barnegat.

areas.name: Region 05: Lower Chesapeake and Hampton Roads
areas.description: Lower Chesapeake, the lower Potomac, Hampton Roads and Norfolk, the Delmarva and Virginia Atlantic coast, Albemarle Sound.

areas.name: Region 06: North Carolina and northern South Carolina
areas.description: Pamlico Sound and Hatteras, the Neuse and Pamlico Rivers, Beaufort and Morehead City, Wilmington and Cape Fear, Myrtle Beach, Charleston, and the Savannah River to Augusta.

areas.name: Region 07: Southern South Carolina, Georgia and northeast Florida
areas.description: Beaufort and Hilton Head, Savannah, the Georgia sea islands, Fernandina, Jacksonville and the St. Johns River, and the Florida coast to Cape Canaveral.

areas.name: Region 02b: Massachusetts and Cape Cod
areas.description: Buzzards Bay, the Elizabeth Islands, Martha's Vineyard and Nantucket, the Cape Cod Canal, Cape Cod Bay, Boston Harbor and Massachusetts Bay north to about Cape Ann.

areas.name: Region 08: Southeast Florida
areas.description: The Indian River Lagoon south of Cape Canaveral, the Atlantic coast and ICW from Sebastian to Miami, Biscayne Bay, and the upper Keys to Key Largo.

areas.name: Region 10: Southwest Florida and the Keys
areas.description: Tampa Bay, Sarasota, Charlotte Harbor, Fort Myers and the Caloosahatchee, Naples, the Everglades coast, Florida Bay, and the Keys from Islamorada to Key West and the Dry Tortugas.

areas.name: Region 11: Florida Big Bend to Mississippi Sound
areas.description: The Gulf coast from Tarpon Springs and the Big Bend to Apalachicola, Panama City, Destin, Pensacola, Mobile Bay and Mississippi Sound to Biloxi.

areas.name: Region 15: Lake Erie
areas.description: Lake Erie's US shore from Toledo and the Bass Islands to Sandusky, Cleveland, Erie and Dunkirk, the Detroit River and Lake St. Clair. Great Lakes depths are charted to Low Water Datum, not MLLW.

areas.name: Region 01a: Southern Maine, Lake Champlain and eastern Lake Ontario
areas.description: The New Hampshire and Maine coast from Portsmouth to Casco Bay and Boothbay, Lake Champlain, eastern Lake Ontario (Oswego, Sackets Harbor) and the St. Lawrence through the Thousand Islands.

areas.name: Region 01b: Penobscot Bay to Downeast Maine
areas.description: Rockland, Camden and Penobscot Bay, Blue Hill Bay, Mount Desert Island and Bar Harbor, Frenchman Bay, Jonesport and Machias Bay.

areas.name: Region 01c: Eastport and Passamaquoddy Bay
areas.description: Eastport, Lubec, Cobscook Bay and Passamaquoddy Bay on the Canadian border.

areas.name: Region 12: New Orleans, Lake Pontchartrain and Mississippi Sound
areas.description: The Mississippi River from Baton Rouge past New Orleans, Lake Pontchartrain and Lake Borgne, western Mississippi Sound (Gulfport), Morgan City and the Intracoastal Waterway across Louisiana.

areas.name: Region 13: The Mississippi Delta and Louisiana bayous
areas.description: Louisiana's coast south of 29.33 N: the Mississippi River below Venice and its passes, Barataria Bay and Grand Isle, Terrebonne and Timbalier Bays, and Atchafalaya Bay.

areas.name: Region 14: Texas and western Louisiana
areas.description: Lake Charles and the Calcasieu, Sabine Pass, Galveston Bay and the Houston Ship Channel, Freeport, Matagorda Bay, Corpus Christi, and the Laguna Madre to Brownsville.

areas.name: Region 16: Lake Ontario, the Niagara River and Lake Huron
areas.description: Lake Ontario's US shore from Niagara to Sodus Bay, Buffalo and the Niagara River, the St. Clair River, and Lake Huron's Michigan shore from Port Huron and Saginaw Bay to Alpena and Drummond Island.

areas.name: Region 17a: Northern Lake Michigan and the Straits of Mackinac
areas.description: Green Bay and Door County, Grand Traverse Bay, Charlevoix, Petoskey, Mackinac Island, Cheboygan and the Straits of Mackinac, and Lake Michigan's shores north of Ludington and Manitowoc.

areas.name: Region 17b: Southern Lake Michigan
areas.description: Chicago, Milwaukee, Sheboygan, Michigan City, St. Joseph, Holland, Grand Haven and Muskegon.

areas.name: Region 18: Lake Superior
areas.description: Lake Superior's US shore: Duluth and Two Harbors, the Apostle Islands, Isle Royale, Marquette, Munising, Whitefish Bay, and the St. Marys River at Sault Ste. Marie.

areas.name: Region 19a: Southern California
areas.description: San Diego Bay, Mission Bay, Oceanside, Dana Point, Newport Beach, Long Beach and Los Angeles harbors, and Catalina Island.

areas.name: Region 19b: Central California
areas.description: Santa Monica Bay and Marina del Rey, the Channel Islands, Ventura, Santa Barbara, Morro Bay and Monterey Bay.

areas.name: Region 19c: San Francisco Bay
areas.description: San Francisco Bay, San Pablo Bay, the Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta to Sacramento and Stockton, and the coast from Half Moon Bay to Bodega Bay.

areas.name: Region 19d: Offshore approaches to San Francisco Bay
areas.description: Offshore waters west of San Francisco Bay: the Farallon Islands, Cordell Bank and Bodega Canyon.

areas.name: Region 20a: Northern California and southern Oregon
areas.description: Fort Bragg, Humboldt Bay and Eureka, Crescent City, Brookings, Coos Bay, Florence and Newport (Yaquina Bay).

areas.name: Region 20b: The Columbia River and northern Oregon
areas.description: The Columbia River from the bar to Portland and the Willamette, Tillamook Bay, Willapa Bay and Grays Harbor.

areas.name: Region 22a: Ketchikan and southern Southeast Alaska
areas.description: Ketchikan and Tongass Narrows, Metlakatla, Prince of Wales Island (Craig), Clarence Strait and Dixon Entrance.

areas.name: Region 22b: Wrangell and Petersburg
areas.description: Wrangell, Wrangell Narrows, Petersburg and Sumner Strait.

areas.name: Region 23a: Sitka and Frederick Sound
areas.description: Sitka and Sitka Sound, the outer coasts of Baranof and Chichagof Islands, Chatham Strait, Kake and Frederick Sound.

areas.name: Region 23b: Juneau, Glacier Bay and Lynn Canal
areas.description: Juneau and Auke Bay, Stephens Passage, Icy Strait, Glacier Bay, Lynn Canal to Haines and Skagway, and Yakutat.

areas.name: Region 26b: Adak and the central Aleutians
areas.description: Adak, Atka and the Andreanof Islands.

areas.name: Region 28b: The main Hawaiian Islands
areas.description: Oahu and Honolulu, Maui, Lanai, Molokai, the Big Island (Hilo, Kona) and Kauai.

areas.name: Region 30: The western Aleutians
areas.description: The Rat and Near Islands: Kiska, Shemya and Attu.

areas.name: Region 09: Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands
areas.description: Puerto Rico (San Juan, Fajardo, Ponce), Vieques and Culebra, and the US Virgin Islands (St. Thomas, St. John, St. Croix).

areas.name: Region 20c: Puget Sound and the San Juan Islands
areas.description: Puget Sound from Olympia to Seattle and Everett, Hood Canal, the Strait of Juan de Fuca, the San Juan Islands, Bellingham, and the Washington coast north of Grays Harbor.

areas.name: Region 24a: Prince William Sound and Yakutat
areas.description: Prince William Sound (Valdez, Cordova, Whittier), the Copper River delta, and the coast east to Yakutat Bay.

areas.name: Region 24b: Kenai Peninsula and Kodiak
areas.description: Seward and Resurrection Bay, Kenai Fjords, Cook Inlet (Homer, Seldovia, Anchorage), and Kodiak.

areas.name: Region 25a: Alaska Peninsula and Bristol Bay east
areas.description: Shelikof Strait, the Alaska Peninsula's Pacific coast to Chignik, and eastern Bristol Bay (Naknek, Dillingham).

areas.name: Region 25b: Shumagin Islands, King Cove and Cold Bay
areas.description: The Shumagin Islands and Sand Point, King Cove, Cold Bay, False Pass and western Bristol Bay.

areas.name: Region 26a: Unalaska and the eastern Aleutians
areas.description: Dutch Harbor and Unalaska, Akutan, Umnak and the Islands of Four Mountains, and the Pribilof Islands.

areas.name: Region 27: Arctic and western Alaska
areas.description: Norton Sound and Nome, the Yukon delta, Bering Strait, Kotzebue Sound, and the Arctic coast to Utqiagvik and Prudhoe Bay.

areas.name: Region 28a: Northwestern Hawaiian Islands and Johnston Atoll
areas.description: Nihoa, Necker, French Frigate Shoals, Gardner Pinnacles, Midway and Johnston Atoll.

areas.name: Region 29: American Samoa and the central Pacific
areas.description: Tutuila (Pago Pago), the Manu'a Islands, Swains Island, Rose Atoll, Palmyra, Kingman Reef, Jarvis, Howland and Baker Islands.

areas.name: Region 31a: Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands
areas.description: Guam (Apra Harbor), Rota, Tinian and Saipan, and the northern Marianas.

areas.name: Region 31b: Micronesia and Wake Island
areas.description: Pohnpei, Kosrae and other islands of the Federated States of Micronesia, and Wake Island.
